messages:
Elaine (Design): Quick question on export UX — should users be able to multi-select rows in the Vectors preview and either 'Copy Vectors' (clipboard) or 'Download CSV'? Want to align with batch flow.
Tom (PM): +1 for both. Copy for quick dev checks, CSV for analytics. Also want a visible selection count in the toolbar.
Mia (Eng): Feasible. Copy would stringify vectors — need decision on delimiter and vector field name. CSV ok but could be large. We should warn on exports > 10k rows.
Ravi (Engineering): Performance note: building CSV on the client vs server matters. For large batches server-streaming or pre-signed S3 export might be necessary.
Elaine (Design): For microcopy: suggestion for export modal — header "Export selected vectors" body "Includes id, source text, and vector features. Max 50k rows per export." CTA: "Download CSV" / "Copy to clipboard". Thoughts?
Sam (Accessibility): Keyboard focus: selection checkboxes must be focusable and announcement should say "X rows selected" via aria-live. Copy action should announce "Vectors copied to clipboard".
Tom (PM): Agree. Also, selection should persist when switching tabs between 'Preview' and 'Relevance table' — saves selection in local state or backend?
Mia (Eng): We'll likely keep in-memory (localStorage) per user per dataset for now. Backend persistence adds complexity.
Ravi (Engineering): If we do localStorage, watch for quota. Maybe store only ids, not raw vectors.
Elaine (Design): UI nit — selection badge should be compact: "3 selected" with clear there's more actions in a kebab menu. Avoid modal overkill for small exports.
Sam (Accessibility): Contrast check — badge bg should meet AA with white text. Also tooltip content needs accessible name.
design-bot: Figma mockup: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/embeddings-export-flow (updated with selection controls)
Elaine (Design): Copy tweak: instead of "Copy vectors" use "Copy vectors (JSON)" and describe format: one JSON array per row? maybe one JSON per line? Prefer newline-delimited JSON for large copies.
Mia (Eng): Ndjson is better for large copies, more streamable. We'll implement "Copy as NDJSON" and "Download CSV".
Tom (PM): Prioritize: 1) selection + badge 2) Copy as NDJSON 3) Download CSV streaming 4) a11y announcements. Schedule in next sprint?
Elaine (Design): Sounds good. I'll update the mock and write the copy. Will create two microcopy variants for review. :thumbsup:
Ravi (Engineering): FYI: for CSV headers we should use stable names: id, source_text, vector_1536 (or vector_dim_{n}). Keep consistent with embeddings API.
Elaine (Design): Proposed CSV header sample (in modal):
```
id,source_text,vector_dim_1536
1234,"How to reset token?",[0.0034,-0.12,...]
```
Elaine (Design): I'll post the microcopy options here tomorrow. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
